provenance: כל תוכן נכתב לפרויקט; ⛔ לא נועץ ב-R-010 (מאל"ו) ולא ב-R-013 (AnkiWeb) ולא במילון NC. מהרשימות החיצוניות נקראה עמודת הכותרות של NGSL v1.2 בלבד (CC BY-SA 4.0) לצורך בחירת המילים; הגדרות המראה נזרקו בלי שנקראו.
headword_source: NGSL v1.2 (CC BY-SA 4.0, newgeneralservicelist.com), column 1 only, read from the github.com/evan-007/ngsl-dictionary mirror per TD-17. Ranks 361-405, the 45 most frequent headwords with no row in data/generated/.
selection_rule: most frequent first; a headword already carrying any row in data/generated/*.jsonl was skipped. 360 headwords were already covered before this run.
sense_policy: D-021 - one row per sense. 45 headwords produced 65 senses; 15 headwords are polysemous here (walk, care, subject, record, mind, past, force, grow, light x3, stop, class, matter, figure, answer, type, shop, note, fund, top).

gate.how: node --experimental-strip-types importing gateSense directly; every row passed through it on both passes
gate.result: pass 1: 64/65 ok, 1 rejected (past#1, level drift on "cart"). one repair round applied. pass 2: 65/65 ok, 0 rejected, 0 discarded.
gate.pre_write_check: Rule A'1 ran on the FULL drafted file, not on a candidate list (lesson 9/11): one closed five-class regex sweep over every example and every stem for spelled numerals above one, day/month names, British -our/-re/-ise spellings, units of measure, and proper nouns. It caught exactly one hit - "two children" in the supportive example of mother#1, born while phrasing - which was rewritten to "a large family" BEFORE the gate ran. That is the class of miss lesson 11 predicts, caught this time by the mechanical sweep rather than by the gate.
gate.post_gate_check: Every stem was scanned by regex for a plural-forcing quantifier immediately before the blank (lesson 8): one hit, "All ____ must wear a name card" on staff#1, rewritten to "The whole ____". Distractor mix verified programmatically as 2 semantic / 1 orthographic / 1 unrelated on all 65 rows. Article agreement before the blank was scanned programmatically for a/an give-aways: none. Max single-sentence length 10 tokens, min stem 5 tokens. Every distractor was substituted into all three of its own stems before writing (lessons 6-7); antonyms were excluded by rule, which is why stop/continue, win/lose, past/future, light/dark and answer/question do not appear as distractors of one another.

distractor_policy: 2 semantic (same field, different selection category - never an antonym and never a near-synonym) + 1 orthographic (differing by a letter inside the word, never headword+regular suffix, per lesson 4) + 1 unrelated.

spot_check.note: batch is smaller than 80, so every sense is marked spot_check=true
